quests.title: An Invitation From the Spark Knight

dialogue.t: Mr.(Miss) Honorary Knight! You're here too!
Amber told me that there's gonna be a race here, and loads of other cool activities.
I'm having the best time. The nice people running the stalls gave me loads and loads of gifts to take home with me.
Here, have this snowman. I won it from one of the games.
If you ever have some free time, we should go play it together!

quests.description: Klee seems to be looking for you…
